title: Interactome-based deep learning points to a SMAD3-TP63-STAT2-STAT3 module in MASH
summary: The DT-LEMBAS interactome-based deep-learning ensemble, decomposed with Jacobian path analysis, identified a four-node SMAD3, TP63, STAT2 and STAT3 module in TGFb-IFNa competition in MASH. The mechanistic hypotheses were experimentally validated in primary hepatocyte spheroids. This is an in vitro preprint.
ai_technology: Interactome-based deep-learning signaling network (DT-LEMBAS) with gradient-based decomposition
organization: Department of Biological Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, USA

evidence.tested: Experimental tests of the predicted mediators in primary hepatocyte spheroids.
evidence.unknown: In vivo or clinical relevance to MASH fibrosis; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep signaling-network model was decomposed to pick out the mediators tested experimentally.
